summary: Iteration 9 — LIFETIME OWNER + NDIS AI CODE ASSISTANT verified. Backend: 16/16 pytest passed (backend_iteration9_test.py). Lifetime seed: POST /api/auth/login with TEST_USER_EMAIL/admin returns 200 + token; GET /api/billing/membership returns {plan:'lifetime', is_active:true, status:'active', expires_at:'2999-01-01T00:00:00+00:00', auto_renew:false}; /auth/me confirms the user record. NDIS AI Assistant (GPT-4o via Emergent LLM key, grounded on the 25-item catalogue): (a) self-care weekday query returns real catalogue code 01_011_0107_1_1 with name/rate/unit, (b) community-access/shopping query returns 04_104_0125_6_1, (c) out-of-scope 'bake a chocolate cake' returns codes that are either empty OR filtered against catalogue (backend maps by code so invented codes are dropped) — no fake codes leaked, (d) multi-turn conversation with follow-up 'And on a Sunday?' correctly returns the Sunday variant 01_004_0107_1_1, (e) empty messages → 400. Non-lifetime demo user still sees Free plan + Stripe checkout URL from /billing/checkout. NDIS catalogue endpoint returns >=20 items. Regression: /dashboard/stats, /billing/plans (pro_monthly A$19.99, pro_yearly A$199), /auth/me 401 without token, /auth/logout all pass. Frontend (390x844 mobile web): 7/7 UI flows verified — (1) lifetime login → dashboard-screen loads, (2) 'NDIS Code Assistant' banner (testID=assistant-banner) is visible on dashboard, (3) tapping banner opens assistant-screen, (4) typing question in assistant-input and pressing assistant-send returns an assistant bubble AND a tappable code chip (testID=use-code-01_011_0107_1_1) within ~10s, (5) tapping the chip navigates to /invoice/new?presetCode=01_011_0107_1_1&presetDesc=Assistance%20With%20Self-Care%20Activities%20-%20Standard%20-%20Weekday%20Daytime&presetRate=67.56 (invoice prefill working), (6) /membership shows 'Full access — no fees, ever 🎉' status pill (testID=membership-status), a 'You have lifetime access' card, all 5 features listed, and NO subscribe-pro_monthly / subscribe-pro_yearly buttons rendered, (7) bottom 5-tab bar (Command / Clients / Scan / Invoices / Planner) is present on both /membership and /account with NO leaked extra tabs. Demo (non-lifetime) regression: TEST_DEMO_EMAIL / TEST_PASSWORD logs in, /membership renders both plan-pro_monthly and plan-pro_yearly cards. Auth regression: unauth users are redirected to /login. Confirmed biometric/PIN is optional — lifetime user's Account screen shows 'Set quick-unlock PIN' row (opt-in) and no lock overlay appears without a PIN.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py — Lifetime seed on startup is IDEMPOTENT: if the email exists it updates plan/status/expires_at; if not it inserts a fresh user. Uses `datetime(2999,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)` as far-future expiry. `_membership_out` computes is_active by comparing the tz-aware expiry to now → lifetime user correctly shows is_active:true.

backend/server.py — /api/ai/ndis-assistant is grounded correctly: (a) system prompt embeds the whole 25-item catalogue with code|name|category|rate|unit|tags, (b) STRICT JSON response schema {answer, codes:[code,...]} enforced, (c) backend post-filters by `if c in by_code` so any hallucinated code IDs are dropped from the response — the frontend can never receive a fake code. Multi-turn works via last-8-message transcript window.

backend/server.py — Assistant catches ```-fenced JSON and extracts the {..} region defensively (start/end brace search). Fallback: if JSON parse fails, `answer` becomes the raw text and codes=[] — safe default.

frontend/app/(tabs)/membership.tsx — Lifetime UI branch (`isLifetime = currentPlan === 'lifetime'`) is clean: renders the special lifetime card and completely bypasses the plans list / cancel button. Status text 'Full access — no fees, ever 🎉' matches spec.

frontend/app/(tabs)/assistant.tsx — KeyboardAvoidingView + ScrollView pattern is correct for RN mobile. Sends the full user/assistant history array (last state after appending the new user msg) to the backend so the multi-turn context is preserved. Code chips have testID=`use-code-<code>` and applyCode() navigates to /invoice/new with URL-encoded params — verified prefill works end-to-end.
frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx — assistant-banner is a real Pressable with distinctive brand-tinted styling; sits between Start Shift and Quick Actions — good IA placement.
